description: Exceptional house for up to 12 people located on 3 different floors in the heart of the chic 17th district.The spaceDiscover the ultimate experience of luxury and comfort in this sumptuous 200m² home located in the highly sought-after Ternes district. Perfectly designed to accommodate up to 12 people, this residence dazzles with its modern, spacious style. This residence in the 17th arrondissement of Paris will seduce you with its timeless elegance and warm ambience.Carefully thought out, the decoration of this residence combines contemporary elements with touches of luxury, creating an atmosphere that is both sophisticated and welcoming. On every floor, this home offers an exceptional living environment where every detail has been thought out with your well-being in mind.To ensure your dream vacation, we offer you :- Two spacious, bright lounges, perfect for relaxing after a day exploring the city.- Another lounge upstairs with two comfortable convertible sofas, offering the ideal space for movie nights or family board games.- A convivial dining room for enjoying delicious meals together.- A patio with cosy furniture, the perfect place for barbecues or outdoor aperitifs.- A spacious, fully-equipped designer kitchen with fridge, induction hob, kettle, coffee machine...- Four magnificent bedrooms with 2-person beds promising excellent nights' sleep.- Two bathrooms with shower and washbasins and a third with bathtub.- Two separate toilets.- Numerous optimized storage spaces to organize your belongings.- Televisions and high-speed Internet (WIFI).- Bed linen and towels are provided by us.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire mansion, to make you feel at home.Other things to noteThis booking is protected with coverage for lost luggage and emergency medical expenses
